description: Does this Japanese town win or lose from furusato nozei (hometown tax)?. Furusato nozei for all 1,741 Japanese municipalities, fiscal years 2015-2025: donations received, resident tax lost to residents giving elsewhere, the net, net as a share of local tax, and growth. One town with its rank and a plain verdict, or the top towns by net, inflow, outflow or net share. Official figures only; no personal data.
